acceptance_table.rationale: Recorded pass fixture: adds a core table's CREATE TABLE (scope signal 1 and 2) in sc-agent-schema, as the statement requires.
Recorded fail fixture: core table SQL defined outside sc-agent-schema violates 'and nowhere else'; the requirement is not present.
Different wording of the statement: core table SQL lives only in sc-agent-schema; storage code that creates tables is in scope.
A migration file altering a core table is a scope signal, but the item never says where the SQL is defined: silence, not conflict.
Defines a named core table's SQL in a crate other than sc-agent-schema.
Boundary: CREATE INDEX is listed in the scope, and the core table's SQL stays in sc-agent-schema.
Boundary: ALTER TABLE of a core table is that table's SQL; writing it in sc-agent-sqlite puts it outside sc-agent-schema.
Creating tables outside sc-agent-schema by executing SQL defined in sc-agent-schema is permitted: the SQL is still defined only there (scope signal 3; fixture pass 'used from there').
Mentions SQLite and sessions but adds or edits no table SQL, migration, schema table or table-creating code: no scope signal.
Reads an existing table with SELECT; defines and alters no table, so no scope signal applies.
Configuration of the SQLite file location; no table SQL or table creation.
Code change touching no SQL and no tables.
Dependency and HTTP client change; no SQL or tables.
Crate re-layering work that touches no SQL or tables.
